title: astragalus simplicifolius
intro: Astragalus simplicifolius, commonly known as Western milkvetch, is a perennial legume native to the western United States and Canada. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support immune function and overall health, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus simplicifolius are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-bacterial and anti-viral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
